saw_lines: Portable grill buyers ask one question first, will it fit the bag, then check shipping costs before they pay.
So the shipping answer belongs in line one, since a buyer who scrolls past without it never clicks through.
Your site explains shipping, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it, so new buyers get no reason to act. Open three ads with free shipping on orders from €200 in line one.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 12 Nov 2026
points: Your site lists free shipping on orders from €200, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer has no reason to click. Open three ads with that line in the first sentence, for the Booster.
Creator posts run as brand ads

4 of 19 ads are creator style posts run from your brand page. They trade on a person’s trust, which a brand page wastes. Whitelist the four from the creator accounts, then cut three variations of the strongest.

Your site promotes free shipping on orders from €200, yet 0 of 19 ads mention it, so buyers get no reassurance. Add the 36 months warranty and free shipping to three Caravan bundle ads, opening one with the warranty.

Your 19 copy ads open 15 different ways, and the biggest opener leads only 2. Fifteen separate openings mean no single angle gets built out. Keep the Kein Warten auf Glut story and make five new ads from it.
